Metadata.title: Lunar — A Dynamic Island for Windows 11
Metadata.description: Lunar is a small pill at the top of your screen with a pair of eyes that watch over your desktop. Free, open source, private.

Common.tagline: A Dynamic Island for Windows 11, with a pair of eyes that watch over your desktop.

Footer.copyright: © 2026 Rafael Evan Kristanto. Lunar is free and open source under the Apache License 2.0.
Footer.notAffiliated: Not affiliated with Apple or Anthropic.

system.name: System
system.summary: Clock, volume and brightness, Wi-Fi and Bluetooth, and the Translate button

media.name: Media
media.summary: What's playing in any app, with play, pause, previous, next and seeking

pomodoro.name: Pomodoro
pomodoro.summary: A focus timer from 1 to 180 minutes that turns on Do Not Disturb

converter.name: File converter
converter.summary: Convert PNG, JPG and PDF, or turn pictures into a Word document, offline

notes.name: Notes
notes.summary: Quick notes that save as you type, and the voice recorder

usage.name: Usage
usage.summary: Your Claude 5-hour and weekly limits, off until you turn it on

pomodoro.hint: Starting also turns on Do Not Disturb until the time is up.

converter.hint: Pictures and PDFs, converted on this PC

tour.lead: Click the eyes, then swipe or use the arrow keys to move between six pages. Scroll to walk through them here.

Download.notWindows: Lunar is for Windows 11 PCs. Copy the link and open it on your PC.

live.title: The island shows what's happening
live.lead: While something is going on, the closed island turns into it. Pick one, or let it play.
live.autoplay: Playing by itself. Pick one to stop.

share.title: Invisible in screen shares
share.lead: Drag the line. On your screen Lunar is right there; in Teams, Zoom or Meet nobody else sees it.
share.slider: Compare your screen with what others see
share.notes: Notes: ask about the launch date

translate.title: Translate your screen in place
translate.lead: Press Ctrl+Alt+T and the text on your screen is shown in another language, right over the original. Try it here.
translate.note: Machine translation can be wrong. In Lunar the text is read on your PC; only the text goes to Azure, with your own key.

light.title: Light as a feather
light.source: Measured over five minutes on a typical laptop.

privacy.title: Your privacy
privacy.off: Off until you turn it on
privacy.daily: Once a day, can be turned off

install.title: Install in a minute
install.smartBody: Microsoft Defender SmartScreen prevented an unrecognised app from starting.
install.illustration: A simplified drawing of the warning, not the real window.

cta.title: Give your desktop a pair of eyes
cta.lead: Free, small, and it stays out of your way.

features.title: Features
features.lead: Six pages in the island, two styles, and a few things that work without opening it.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.lead: What Lunar does with your data, in short. The full notice is installed next to the app and on GitHub.
privacy.tableTitle: Everything that can leave your PC

download.title: Download Lunar
download.lead: One small installer for Windows 11. No account, no administrator rights.

changelog.title: Changelog
changelog.lead: What changed in each version of Lunar.

notFound.title: Lunar can't find that page
notFound.body: The link may be old or mistyped. The island is still here, though.
